title: Repairs & maintenance of Kanhoji Angre Island Lighthouse Station
summary: E-tender for civil repairs and maintenance (dismantling, plumbing and sanitary fittings, rainwater pipes, painting, plastering, granite and boat hire) at Kanhoji Angre Lighthouse on Khanderi Island, Raigad, Maharashtra.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, M.G. Road, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai

sites.name: Kanhoji Angre Lighthouse Station, Khanderi Island, Raigad, Maharashtra
sites.work: Repairs and maintenance: dismantling, plumbing/sanitary, rainwater pipes, fittings, granite, painting, plastering, brickwork, boat and labour carriage

scope.item: Dismantling existing unserviceable wooden/steel doors, windows, ventilators, cupboards (area 3 sqm and below)
Dismantling aluminium sheet roofing incl. ridges, hips, valleys, gutters
Dismantling old plaster or skirting, raking joints and cleaning surface
Dismantling C.I./asbestos 100 mm rain water pipe with fittings and clamps
Demolishing R.C.C. work manually/mechanically
Dismantling W.C. pan and flushing cistern
CPVC pipes for hot and cold water, concealed: 15 mm (11 Rmt), 20 mm (6 Rmt), 25 mm (6 Rmt), 32 mm (25 Rmt); 40 mm exposed (30 Rmt)
Wall mounted white vitreous china single piece syphonic water closet with integrated 10 litre dual flush cistern (Jaquar/Parryware/Hindware)
White vitreous china wash basin 550x400 mm with 15 mm CP brass single hole basin mixer
600x450 mm bevelled edge mirror
PTMT towel rail 600 mm
CP brass napkin holder
PTMT soap dish holder
600x120x5 mm glass shelf on anodised aluminium frame

Water supply fittings (2 each): CP bib cock, concealed stop cock, angle valve, 100 mm shower rose, PTMT waste coupling, 40 mm PVC waste pipe, mosquito proof coupling, single lever telephonic wall mixer, jet with flexible tube, flush cock, PVC connection pipe, 25/32/40 mm CPVC valves, 15 mm flexible geyser pipe
Unplasticised rigid PVC rain water pipe 110 mm (IS 13592 Type A), single socketed
110 mm PVC fittings: pushfit coupler, single tee with door, 87.5 deg bend, CI grating inlet (6 each)
Renewing galvanised wire mesh

Replacement of door/window fittings: MS sliding door bolts (6), brass door handles (6), hooks and eyes (4), aluminium tower bolts 150 mm (8) and 100 mm (8), brass butt hinges heavy (6) and ordinary (7)
18 mm black granite, gang saw cut, mirror polished, on 20 mm CM 1:4
Removing distemper/enamel/cement paint from interior and exterior walls
White cement based putty 1 mm on interior walls (Asian/Berger/Shalimar)
Premium acrylic smooth exterior paint with silicone additives, two or more coats (Asian/Snowcem/Berger)
Synthetic enamel paint two or more coats (Asian/Berger/Shalimar)
Polyurethane floor paint over old paver block internal pathway/road (Asian/Indigo/Dulux)
Brick work with common burnt clay FPS bricks class 7.5 in CM 1:4
18 mm cement plaster in two coats (12 mm 1:5 + 6 mm 1:3)
Hire of mechanised boats/pontoons for potable water (incl. pumping to storage tank), labour and materials from Thal jetty to Kanhoji Angre landing
Labour for carriage of construction material from Kanhoji Angre landing to lighthouse premises

money.performance_security: Performance guarantee 5% of contract value (FDR/BG) before work order, released on completion; plus security deposit 5% deducted from RA bills, released after 6 months defect liability period
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST; BOQ total Rs 21,20,958.40 including boat hire Rs 75,000 and carriage labour Rs 30,000. EMD by DD/FDR of scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months; MSME/NSIC bidders must also pay EMD. Minimum average annual turnover 30% of estimate (Rs 6,36,287).

period.completion: 01 month from date of issue of work order
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category with Central Govt./State Govt./Municipal Corporation, with tender limit equal to or more than estimated cost

Similar works (civil construction, repair and maintenance) in last 7 years with Central/State/UT Government organisations: three works each >= Rs 8.48 lakh (40%), or two each >= Rs 12.72 lakh (60%), or one >= Rs 16.96 lakh (80%); only fully completed works; certificates from officers below Executive Engineer not considered; sub-contractor experience not considered
Average annual turnover at least 30% of estimated cost over last 3 financial years, CA certified
PAN, GST registration, income tax returns for three years
Tender acceptance letter, unconditional bid undertaking, bid securing declaration, notarised non-blacklisting affidavit, declaration of no relatives in DGLL/MoPSW, Make in India self-certification

Technical evaluation score of at least 70/100 (statutory 30, financial 20, experience 20, client performance certificates 20, key personnel 10: one graduate civil engineer and two diploma civil engineers)
specs: Works to CPWD specifications; cement 53 grade OPC/PPC from ISI-licensed manufacturers; sand to IS 2686; bricks to IS 1077
Paint shades: snow/brilliant white (trestle, GI and RCC tower), signal red (trestle tower), bus green (automation box and hand rail), black (gate, pedestal, RCC tower)
Site is on an island reachable only by boat from Thal (Alibag) or Gateway of India jetty
notes: Full 70-page tender document; GCC (Section IV), SCC (Section V) and annexure forms are standard boilerplate. BOQ in Section VII carries estimated rates. Bid download/submission 09/10/2025 16:00 to 14/10/2025 16:00, only five days, with a one-month completion period for a Rs 21 lakh island work. Tender acceptance letter template cites reference CM-MUM-03012(01)/1/2021 while the NIT cites CM-MUM-03012(03)/1/2021. Clause 3.1 mentions turnover years ending 31/03/2024 and 31/03/2025 inconsistently. Page 71 contains only a page number.
